# R5.20 — Prove retained treatment reaches exact provider bytes

## Summary

Closes the retained-view→wire integration the R5.19 split-review's
B3→T2 boundary names (Packet B B.2 "retained-view→wire | gateway +
hh-embed render"; REQ-E-206 owner slice; REQ-A-007; REQ-D-005
contributing). `GatewayModel` — the existing renderer — now consumes
the latest durable `retained_selection/1` (strict decode + R5.18
`verify_selection` replay) and drops every omitted `context_item_id`
from the rendered join; omitted content can never reappear on the
wire. A malformed/unknown/divergent record is a typed
`MalformedHistory` plan refusal — a strategy label without execution
never dispatches. `view_hash` (landed §5b.1 spelling) is stamped on
`model.call.requested` — the consumed member's own idp address,
identical to `prepare`'s `view_ref` over the same member.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-embed/src/gateway_model.rs` — `selected_view()` consult +
  render filter + `view_hash` member (~100 lines).
- `crates/hh-embed/src/runtime.rs` — `OBSERVATION_ITEM_IDP` moved to
  the render module as `pub(crate)` (one home for mint + join).
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r5_20.rs` — the AC battery: real `compact()`
  mints the member; loopback provider captures literal socket bytes;
  `prepared::prepare`/`dispatch` proves sealed-request→wire joins.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0398-*.md` + regenerated index/triggers; coverage
  dated contributing note; `docs/build/runs/R5.20.md`.

## ACs → evidence

- AC-1 (positive): both admitted policies + restart/fallback/retry —
  captured bytes carry exactly the retained set; `PreparedBytesMutated`
  sealed-verify; `view_hash == view_ref`; `request_ref` on the durable
  row. `r5_20.rs` 5/5.
- AC-2 (negative): diverged label → `plan_error` zero wire; unknown
  variant refused; unadmitted capability/unlisted endpoint →
  `InvalidPlan`; mutated sealed bytes → `PreparedBytesMutated`; absent

- AC-3: coverage dated note (achieved engineered D/E; R/P +

- AC-4: fails-without at base `f99d806c` (5/5 red); fmt OK;

- AC-5: REQ-E-206, REQ-A-007 stamped; REQ-D-005 contributing; no
